name: Cell308 R5 combined synthetic evidence

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/cell308-claude-r5-integration]
    paths:
      - level4/closure_proofs/p5y_k5_cell308_research/streams/CLOUD_R1_LINUX_DEV/*.py
      - level4/closure_proofs/p5y_k5_cell308_research/streams/CLOUD_R1_LINUX_DEV/tests/*.py
      - .github/workflows/cell308-r5-integration.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  synthetic-only:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      DEV: level4/closure_proofs/p5y_k5_cell308_research/streams/CLOUD_R1_LINUX_DEV
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      PYTHONWARNINGS: error
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Bind exact source and synthetic-only command
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git diff --exit-code
          git status --porcelain=v1 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/status-before.txt"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/status-before.txt"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/source-commit.txt"
          python -VV > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/python.txt"
          uname -a > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/kernel.txt"
      - name: Full baseline and strict property mutations
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          unset LX_PLATFORM_DIR
          cd "$DEV"
          python -B -W error tests/run_mutants.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/mutations.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/harness.stdout.log" 2> "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/harness.stderr.log"
      - name: Preserve raw suite traces and verify evidence completeness
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git diff --exit-code
          git status --porcelain=v1 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/status-after.txt"
          test ! -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/cell308-r5-evidence/status-after.txt"
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os
          from pathlib import Path
          folder = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'cell308-r5-evidence'
          evidence = folder / 'mutations.json'
          if not evidence.is_file():
              raise SystemExit('mutation evidence missing; inspect harness logs')
          rec = json.loads(evidence.read_text())
          suites = [('baseline', rec['baseline'])] + [(r['id'], r['suite']) for r in rec['mutants'] if 'suite' in r]
          for label, suite in suites:
              (folder / f'{label}.stdout.txt').write_text(suite['stdout'])
              (folder / f'{label}.stderr.txt').write_text(suite['stderr'])
          manifest = {p.name: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(folder.iterdir()) if p.is_file()}
          (folder / 'artifact-sha256.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
          assert rec['source_commit'] == os.environ['GITHUB_SHA']
          assert rec['system'] == 'Linux' and rec['class'] == 'SYNTHETIC_VALIDATION' and rec['dev_only'] is True
          assert rec['new_target_evaluations'] == 0
          assert rec['inputs_unchanged'] and rec['full_registry_completed'] and rec['pass']
          assert rec['unmutated_suite'] == 'PASS'
          assert rec['expected_mutants'] == rec['total'] == rec['killed'] == 133
          assert len(suites) == 134
          for _, suite in suites:
              assert suite['ran'] == rec['expected_test_count']
              assert suite['errors'] == suite['skipped'] == 0
              assert not suite['timed_out'] and not suite['invalid_reasons']
          PY
      - name: Upload complete immutable-input evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: cell308-r5-synthetic-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cell308-r5-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
